steps.content: Nino opens her eyes to find herself in a closed space.
The space is entirely white, with only essential facilities including a bed and a bathroom.
Apart from that, there's an enormous game room filled with heaps of games and live streaming equipment.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: That shadowy thing didn't lie to me...
Like admiring antiques, Nino carefully picks out a disc from one of the shelves in the game room.
The cover image seems to be a father and his son standing side by side on an icy plain, about to embark on an epic adventure.
She tries hard to recognize the words on the cover, but this is a product from before Nightfall after all, so she can barely make out a few words like Lord of War.
Nino sighs, wishing she had spent more time in the Retro Games section of DisMyth. She blames her obsession with flaming as she lets the clue slip away reluctantly.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Right, I have my phone!
She slaps her thigh and fumbles for her phone. Just as she's debating whether to take a photo or start a potential viral post on DisMyth first...
Live stream begins in one minute. Please turn on the computer and get ready.
A voice comes out from somewhere in the room.
She hurriedly drops her phone to investigate the source of the audio in the room.
Live stream begins in 30 seconds. Please get ready.
The voice keeps echoing in the room, but she can't find its source anywhere.
Live stream has begun. Please prepare to start streaming, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.
She looks at the computer in front of her and it's surprisingly identical to the one she has at home.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Why is that thing forcing me to stream? What does it mean by extreme measures?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Too bad for you, Nino Sama is fearless. Show me what you can do then.
Resistance detected. Live stream has not started. Extreme measures will be taken.
Every object in the room except the computer starts belching out smoke. A few discs have caught fire. Nino quickly jumps forward to put out the flames.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Okay, okay! You want me to start streaming, right? I'll do it... I'll stream these games for the sake of playing them!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But mind you... You, the voice in the room, you'd better not let me catch you... or else... I'll be streaming myself hammering you into the ground!
She takes a deep breath and indignantly clicks the Start Streaming button.
